title: Rotting Oranges
summary: Every minute, each rotten orange rots its fresh neighbors that share an edge.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10 rows and 1–10 columns. The rectangular grid contains only integer 0, 1, and 2 values.

statement: Every minute, each rotten orange rots its fresh neighbors that share an edge. Cells contain 0 for empty, 1 for fresh, and 2 for rotten. Return the fewest minutes until no fresh orange remains, or −1 if some fresh orange cannot rot.

examples.explanation: The rot advances one cell each minute.
The empty cell blocks spread to the fresh orange.
There is no fresh orange at the start.

constraints: 1–10 rows and 1–10 columns. The rectangular grid contains only integer 0, 1, and 2 values.
hints: Conceptual: Rotten oranges spread at the same time, so updates from the current minute should not advance the clock twice.
Directional: Queue every initially rotten orange and count the fresh oranges.
Implementation: Assign new neighbors the current minute plus one. When the queue finishes, return −1 if any fresh orange remains.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(mn) auxiliary space for the queue and visit state.
